description: This file defines a Java interface 'BatteryBackedUp' which extends another interface 'BatteryPowered'. It declares methods related to the power backup status of a device, including checks and setters for AC power loss, battery condition (bad or missing).

classes.name: BatteryBackedUp
classes.description: Java interface representing backup power capabilities and status checks for a device.

methods.name: isACPowerLost
methods.description: Checks if the device has lost AC power.

methods.name: setACPowerLost
methods.description: Sets the status indicating whether AC power is lost.

methods.name: isBatteryBad
methods.description: Checks if the device's battery is considered bad.

methods.name: setBatteryBad
methods.description: Sets the battery condition as bad or not.

methods.name: isBatteryMissing
methods.description: Checks if the battery is missing.

methods.name: setBatteryMissing
methods.description: Sets the status indicating whether the battery is missing.
